Aisha: heads-up — final QBR deck for AtlasCorp is due EOD tomorrow. Can folks confirm slide owners and any exec asks we should surface? :eyes:
Kai: I'll own the usage + billing slide (slide 4). Pulling cost delta for last 90d and token economics.
Morgan: SE will take demo + onboarding status (slide 6). Need access to their sandbox to demo dataset upload + metrics pipeline.
Priya: I’ll draft the renewal health slide — current health score 42% (onboarding lag + support latency). Need confirmation on SSO rollout date from Eng.
Evan: SSO ETA still end-of-quarter; can confirm Tuesday after cert checks. For the call we should mention the temporary workaround we provided.
Aisha: Two asks before the dry run: (1) gather 1–2 customer quotes for the wins slide, (2) compile top 3 product asks from AtlasCorp for the roadmap handback. Who can triage feedback?
Morgan: I'll scrub the ticket backlog + convo threads and pull top 3 asks. Will dump a CSV into qbr-assets and paste snippets here.
Kai: Also pulling a short ROI bullet: delta in request latency since we enabled prefix caching. Calling out cost/latency tradeoff helps the ask.
Priya: For the renewal ask, I'm proposing expansion to 5 additional seats + priority support. Need help polishing the exec language — @Kai can you pair on ROI bullets?
Kai: Yep, I’ll pair and add a small chart. Also noticed a usage anomaly on 2024-03-12 that dropped throughput ~18% — flagged to Eng.
Evan: Confirmed — root cause was batch-scheduler misconfiguration; patch rolled 03/13, regression test green. I’ll add a short transparency note and timeline.
Aisha: Dry run tomorrow 10:00am PT — @Priya @Kai @Morgan please join. Agenda: 1) 10m exec summary, 2) 10m wins/metrics, 3) 15m demo, 4) 10m asks + next steps. Link: https://meet.link/qbr-dryrun
QBR-bot: Calendar invite created: QBR dry run • 10:00am PT • 10 attendees.
Priya: Posting draft of the exec ask slide by 16:00 today — will include ask script and success criteria.
Morgan: Uploading demo dataset by noon; will include step-by-step notes for the playthrough.
Kai: Drop the cost delta spreadsheet in qbr-assets once ready; I’ll stitch the charts into slide 4.
Aisha: Great — final note: any legal/discount approvals needed before the call? If so ping me and I’ll loop Sales Ops.
Priya: None confirmed yet, will escalate if negotiators are needed.
Aisha: Thanks team — I’ll assemble the deck and share a review link at 17:30. :thumbsup:
